Four authored Hymn Singer SATB parts are transposed uniformly from D minor to E minor. Source 2/2 meter, quarter=130 tempo, all 32 bars, leading quarter rest, ties, slurs, visible rests and silent spacers are preserved; no fixed system breaks or harmony notes are added.
Soprano and bass enter at quarter 1, tenor at quarter 17 and alto at quarter 33. Shared unisons remain separate selectable parts; silence is not filled.

The current selected anthology stanza and refrain are retained exactly, including While journ-'ying, nor and going. The source's extra two stanzas are omitted. Editorial underlay follows source ornaments; more and to each span a two-eighth-note slur.

Compared with the prior melody: source variants include way-far-ing, ness/toil/nor, I before go, ornaments on more/to, and the low Jordan-line pickup. The duration remains 128 quarters, with the source leading rest instead of the prior trailing rest.
The incompatible anthology chord layer is removed. This is a composite edition, not the anthology's printed SATB or an unmodified facsimile.
Only the text source carries an established CC0 instrument; the music has the arranger's separate explicit public-domain dedication.
